title: Survey: Majorities of Americans Back Targeted Steel Tariffs
dek: A survey reported by the Alliance for American Manufacturing finds majorities of Americans back targeted steel tariffs.
summary: According to the Alliance for American Manufacturing, a survey shows majorities of Americans support targeted steel tariffs. No excerpt was provided, so the survey's methodology, sample and exact figures are not given. The publisher is an advocacy group allied with domestic manufacturing.
keyFacts: Survey finds majorities of Americans back targeted steel tariffs
whyItMatters: Public opinion may influence the political durability of US steel trade protection. The source is an advocacy organisation, which readers should weigh when assessing the findings.
implications: Exporters to the US should not assume tariff relief is imminent if public support persists. Domestic producers may cite such findings in policy debates.

related.title: New Harris Poll: 70% of U.S. Voters Back Targeted Steel Tariffs to Maintain American Steel Production
related.dek: A Harris Poll released by the Alliance for American Manufacturing finds 70% of US voters back targeted steel tariffs to maintain domestic production.
